question: Dated player ratings that later models (R07, R08, R15) can read without seeing the game they predict.
method: Each snapshot is a courtlens-rapm-time-decay-v1 fit (same parameters) at one cutoff, using only regular-season games with game_date < cutoff; alpha is reselected inside each snapshot's own window.

Cutoffs for each regular season 2015-16 to 2025-26: the season's first regular-season game date (opener), then the 1st of every month after the opener up to and including the first month start after the season's last regular-season game. 2014-15 is used only as earlier data.
Readers take the latest snapshot whose cutoff is on or before the game date; season-level fits never feed a prediction inside the same season.
An index lists every cutoff with its artifact hash, window start, game count and selected alpha.
selection: Alpha per snapshot as in courtlens-rapm-time-decay-v1.
uncertainty: None in v1 (snapshots carry point estimates and sample support only).
evaluation: Leakage test: adding or changing games on or after a cutoff leaves that snapshot's hash unchanged
Count of snapshots, games per snapshot and selected alphas
acceptance: Every registered cutoff has a snapshot whose recorded cutoff and latest input game date satisfy latest_game_date < cutoff
Two runs reproduce the index hash
limitations: Opener snapshots for 2015-16 see only one prior season
negative_result_policy: Publish snapshot coverage and any cutoff that could not be fitted.
